overview.title: Overview
overview.description: This cycle's bill (the billing period), where the power goes and what needs a look.
overview.noHomeDescription: This account is not a member of a home. Ask the owner for an invite code, or pair a meter.

bill.title: Bill
bill.description: This billing cycle so far, priced tier by tier as the electricity company will.
bill.emptyDescription: This account has no home with a tariff plan to price its energy.

plan.title: Savings plan
plan.description: Pick a few concrete actions from your own home's data, see what they are worth on the tiered bill, then follow them to the end of the cycle.
plan.emptyDescription: A plan needs a home with a tariff and at least a week of readings to know where to save.
plan.noTariffTitle: Your running plan needs a tariff
plan.noTariff: The home has no tariff, so the plan cannot be priced. Add one in Settings to follow it again.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Every device in the home: whether it is on, how much energy it uses and what it costs, estimated from the main meter.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.description: Energy and cost by day and month; against the last cycle and similar homes; the bill forecast for the cycle's end.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Home, location, bill and the summary email.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: What WattPrint told you and what it watches for your home.

byDay.hidden: The owner lets you see by the day, so the by-the-hour parts are hidden.
byDay.charts: The owner lets you see by the day, so charts drawn from moment-by-moment readings are hidden.
